newsitem.title: FRANCE: Three new bomb blasts in Corsica - no casualties.
newsitem.headline: Three new bomb blasts in Corsica - no casualties.

text.p: Unidentified attackers blasted two post offices and a garage with small explosive charges overnight on the troubled French Mediterranean island of Corsica, police said on Friday.
The attacks, respectively in the villages of Furiani, Propriano and Olmeto, caused slight damage and no casualties since all the premises were empty at the time.

No one claimed responsibility for the attacks but they bore the hallmarks of Corsican separatist groups whom authorities hold responsible for hundreds of the estimated 1,200 bomb blasts on the island in the past two years.
The bombings came a day after a member of an elite paramilitary police unit was shot and slightly wounded by a separatist in the north Corsica town of Bastia.
